whats.AI can be a critical enabler for telcos,: Use AI to help your business run better, but do not mistake it for a business plan. You still need a clear way to earn money.
whats.NATIONAL EDUCATION DAY: Experts call for: Experts link AI with critical thinking and practical learning, so managers should build both skills in their teams, not only tool knowledge.
whats.Can banks financing AI data centres be h: Questions are being raised about who is responsible when financing AI data centres affects water and energy. Managers should watch such risks.
whats.AI in India’s Courts: Making Evidence an: AI is being discussed as a way to make court evidence and decisions more accountable, which shows why clear records matter when using AI.
whats.NTT Docomo Business X and ElevenLabs lin: Voice AI is being linked to business phone systems, so managers should think about how it could change customer calls.

term.def: Technology that turns written text into spoken audio. Modern AI versions sound natural, so companies use them in call centres and phone systems.

prompt.prompt: Act as a careful operations advisor. My team plans to use AI for [task]. List 5 risks, how likely each one is, and one simple step to reduce each.

quiz.q: ITnews Asia reports that AI can be a critical enabler for telcos, but not the business model.
quiz.why: The headline separates AI as a helper that improves a business from AI as the business itself.

quiz.q: Telecompaper reports that NTT Docomo Business X and ElevenLabs link voice AI to enterprise telephony.
quiz.why: The headline says voice AI is being connected to business phone systems. It gives no further details.

quiz.q: If an AI tool sounds confident, its answer is probably correct.
quiz.why: AI can state wrong things in a smooth, sure tone. Always check important facts, numbers and names yourself.

quiz.q: You need to know programming to get useful work from an AI tool.
quiz.why: Most AI tools work with plain-language instructions. Clear writing matters far more than coding skills.

quiz.q: AI tools understand your question the way a human colleague does.
quiz.why: AI finds patterns in language and data to produce answers. It does not understand meaning or context like a person.
